proves D = -4(ad-bc)^2 is strictly negative, so NO real roots exist; the negative-discriminant case of the same proof family as the equal-roots items

two rational terms combined into 9x^2 - 34x - 8 = 0 which splits as (x-4)(9x+2); again the clearing is the labour and factorisation the finish
